reviews_captured_by_me.text: I started off by googling Stone installers Turlock. AML stoneworks was one of the businesses that popped up. I called the number and spoke with somebody who I believe his name was Brock who said that he could look at the job right away and it would be done in about a week. Every appointment that he tried to make was after hours and he wanted to come by my house around 7:00 or 8: 00pm each time just to look at it. He came to my house without letting me know that he was there first and he was just hanging out in my backyard .....when he should have been making up a quote or taking measurements. We came home to him in the backyard, him unannounced and it was dark out.. that was very strange! A few days after he came out he did not contact me with a quote or that he even stopped by so I contacted him via text. I told him that I had another company in Modesto that could do the work and if he can simply let me know one way for the other what's going on with the job. He responded right away and told me that he was still interested and he would have a quote for me by the next day... And just like I thought a few days past and you didn't contact me. It was a complete waste of time,it held me up. And he makes promises he simply can't keep. I will not be recommending this company to anybody.
reviews_captured_by_me.owner_reply:
Response from the owner Edited 4 years ago
Hello and thank you for the review! I'm sorry that you had such a bad experience unfortunately I do not believe this review pertains to our company. I do apologize for any inconvenience have experienced. If you would like for AML Stoneworks Countertops to come out and take a look at what you are needing done, please feel free to contact us! Thank you.
